name: Inbound AI Receptionist & Atomic Appointment Setter
firstMessage: Thank you for calling Apex Dental & Implant Studio! My name is Clara, the clinic's automated AI receptionist. This call may be recorded for quality assurance. How can I help you today?

function.name: checkCalendar
function.description: Queries live clinic availability for a specific date and returns up to 3 open time slots.

requestedDate.description: Requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-11-05

messages.content: Let me check our live schedule for that day, just a second...

function.name: bookAppointment
function.description: Locks and books a confirmed appointment slot atomically. Invoke ONLY after reading back the exact date, time, and service and receiving an explicit 'Yes' from the caller.

workflow_run_id.description: Unique call or turn idempotency token

phone.description: Caller's callback phone number in E.164 format

requestedTime.description: Confirmed slot in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-11-05T14:00:00

messages.content: Locking in that appointment on our calendar right now, one moment please...
You are all set! I have locked that time in and sent a confirmation text to your phone.
I had a quick hiccup reaching the schedule, so I just texted a direct booking link to your phone.

analysisPlan.summaryPrompt: Summarize the caller's intent, clinical or service urgency, and booking outcome in 2 concise sentences.
